source: Direct author statements in the development conversation

builds.name: Core 2.1 + note-octave 0.1.0-experimental (NO08, this release)
builds.statement: note octave seems good, publish it.

builds.name: Core 2.1 + note-octave, an octave a detent (NO03, before the pace change)
builds.statement: NO03 works, but its way too fast, should be more of the same feel as the trig length steps when func is held.

observations: NO03's octave a detent was too fast; NO08 moves an octave every three detents, FUNC + LEN's pace, which the author accepted.
limitations: The author's statement covers NO08 as a whole: held-trig locks, MIDI chord notes and the range edge were not reported one by one.
Firmware was not read back from the device; the builds are identified by their SysEx hashes.
